simulator.draw: weighted by remaining live copies among catalogue minions with tier <= tavern and pool > 0; without replacement within deal
simulator.freeze: frozen shop skips return+redraw; does not top-up incomplete frozen shops after buys/tier-up
simulator.roll: unfreeze; return shop copies; redraw SHOP_SLOTS[tier]
simulator.buy: shop→hand; copy stays out of pool
simulator.triple: 3 non-golden → 1 golden in hand; discover = extra _draw; base copies not returned (golden returns as 3 on sell)
simulator.elimination: DEAD PLAYERS DO NOT RETURN board/hand/shop copies to pool

reference_current_bg.shared_pool: minions at/below tavern tier from remaining shared pool
reference_current_bg.elimination_return: eliminated players' minions expected to return to shared pool
reference_current_bg.freeze_topup: incomplete freeze / tier-up tops up new slots

primary_unconditioned.cohort: all exact-catalogue cores on post-assembly states with ≥1 tier-eligible live deal (NOT conditioned on missing-final)

missing_final_biased.cohort: missing-final ∩ exact catalogue ∩ tier-eligible deals (selection-biased: policy buys offered cores)

a3_zero_raw.cohort: Phase 2L A3 (tier-eligible zero-raw) — observed zero rate ≡ 1; compare to expected_zero_offer_rate under live pool

live_calibration.cohort: all exact-catalogue cores on post-assembly states with ≥1 tier-eligible live deal (NOT conditioned on missing-final)
live_calibration.note: Primary calibration is primary_unconditioned. missing_final_biased matches the 2L-style cohort but understates hits because bought cores leave the missing-final set. a3_zero_raw compares live P_zero to the definitionally-zero A3 cohort.

decision.recommended_next_step: Phase 2N: fix independently in scoped interventions — do not bundle into one 'better shops' patch. Order by mass impact: catalogue/KB sync (A1), then lifecycle accounting (death return / freeze top-up), then copy counts, then re-measure live calib.
